title: Wren and the Vector
author: Isandro Vasquez
blurb: August Montrose, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
